# Allotment plan

Plot 14 has four raised beds and a fruit corner. This plan says what goes where this year. #allotment/beds

> [!note] Properties
> The block above the heading is the note's frontmatter. `tags` link to tag pages. `aliases` add names that links and Find match. A value that is one link, like `related`, renders as a link.

## The beds

![[allotment-beds.svg|A plan of four beds in a row, with a fruit corner at the right]]

| Bed | Crop | Sown | Spacing | Water | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Broad beans | March | 20 cm | Weekly | Pinch out the tips in June |
| 2 | Carrots and leeks | April | 5 cm, then 15 cm | Twice a week | Cover against carrot fly |
| 3 | Squash | May | 90 cm | Every other day in July | ==Needs the most compost== |
| 4 | Salad leaves | March to August | 10 cm | Daily in a dry spell | Sow a short row every fortnight |

A wide table scrolls sideways on a phone.

## The fruit corner

The quince tree went in two winters ago.[^1] It shares the corner with three currant bushes.

[^1]: A footnote sits at the foot of the page, with a link back to its place in the text.

> [!warning] Frost
> Fleece the quince blossom when a frost is forecast. ==One cold night can take the whole crop.==
